vendor/tetris.js, vendor/controller.js and vendor/render.js are the original
classic scripts from dionyziz/canvas-tetris. Do not edit them; run
node apps/falling-blocks/vendor.mjs to rebuild from the pin.

  https://github.com/dionyziz/canvas-tetris.git
  commit  4e497d1c858914f0a1f0818698029d1c7dad090b

MIT, Dionysis "dionyziz" Zindros, 2012. The notice travels beside the
scripts as COPYING-canvas-tetris.txt and is packed into the GIF too, so a
copy of this app that someone was handed still carries the notice it is
required to carry.

The original pop.ogg is not shipped — line-clear is silent. The original
index title branded the well-known game; this port does not.
